from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The party's name as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their role in the case (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，再审申请人)")


class JudgmentOutcome(BaseModel):
    """The main judgment outcome and related procedural details."""
    outcome_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of judgment: 驳回上诉，维持原判，准许撤回，指令再审，etc.")
    fee_amount: float | None = Field(description="The second instance case fee amount if mentioned")
    fee_payers: list[str] = Field(description="Who bears the fees, as named in the document")
    confirms_lower_court_ruling: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the judgment confirms/upholds the lower court ruling")
    specific_case_number: str | None = Field(description="The referenced lower court case number if any")
    specific_case_number_description: str | None = Field(description="Description of the case number (e.g., 执行裁定，再审申请)")


class LegalCase(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document for matching purposes."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="The document identifier, e.g., 《判决文书1》")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The case type: 行政，民事，刑事")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All named parties in the case")
    court_level: str | None = Field(description="The court level: 最高人民法院，高级人民法院，中级人民法院，etc.")
    judgment_outcome: JudgmentOutcome | None = Field(description="The main judgment outcome and details")
    case_description: str | None = Field(description="Short description of the case subject matter")


class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level schema aggregating all extracted legal case information."""
    legal_cases: list[LegalCase]
